management_themes: We expect to see growth as large projects start yielding revenue.
Productivity gains will continue to compensate for cannibalization of revenue.
We want to focus on profitable growth and may need to compromise on margins.
We have a strong pipeline and decent deal wins, but re-scoping and negative surprises on demand are a concern.
AI adoption is a core part of our solutioning and will create a tailwind for enterprise adoption.
Client priorities are focused on managing increasing costs in a challenging environment.
risks: Margin pressure due to industry-wide challenges

However, productivity gains from process optimization and growth from digital revenues will help mitigate these challenges. The company will focus on profitable growth and may need to compromise on margins. AI adoption and deployment will continue to create a tailwind for enterprise adoption.
